chunks.heading: GST Registration Pilot: Deferred Threshold for Sole Traders
chunks.text:
Internal Memo: GST Registration Pilot Program Rapid GST Onboarding Pilot (Reference: GST-PILOT-2026-07) Under this pilot, eligible new sole traders may defer standard GST registration until reaching $82,340 cumulative turnover, instead of the usual $75,000 threshold, provided they lodge
Form NT-4 within 14 days of exceeding $75,000 turnover.

chunks.heading: GST Pilot: Eligibility Requirements and Filing Penalties
chunks.text:
Eligibility and Penalties The pilot applies only to sole traders registered after 1 January 2026. Failure to lodge Form NT-4 within the 14-day window voids pilot eligibility and reverts the entity to the standard $75,000 threshold, backdated to the date it was
first exceeded, with standard late-registration penalties.
